- Greens (cooked with cream/dressing, estimated): 57 g x 60 kcal/100g ≈ 34 kcal
- Flatbread with cheese: 43 g x 270 kcal/100g ≈ 116 kcal

Total ≈ 165 kcal, ≈ 125 g.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Visible food covers about a third of a dinner plate with modest portions, so roughly 125 g and 165 kcal is plausible. The greens may be heavier if dressed, so the estimate is approximate.
